What Environment Means To Me

Jul 31, 2016 • Janice Cotcher

About 5 years ago, I created a series of photo collages about what the environment means to me. Over the next couple weeks, I’ll share and explain what they mean to me.

It mostly is comprised of photos I took myself. Unfortunately, a few of them are from unknown sources and I apologize that I’m unable to give credit to them (this is back before I knew I was supposed to reference images).
